Now, he was silently staring at him, his gaze like that of a ravenous dragon lurking in a dark lair for a long time, having just spotted its prey. There was no trace of the docile submission he had shown when he was with him day and night before… his wild nature was revealed.
————————————————————————–
“You did not hurt me? No……you did.
And you also forget,
I will believe you, I will be loyal to
you, forever.”

89271.synopsis:
“Congratulations on your marriage, Kaindel.”
Isaac, who had been Kaindel’s lover—the hero who saved the world from the Great Calamity—learned one day that Kaindel was engaged to a princess. 
Exhausted by their already strained relationship, Isaac eventually decided to leave Kaindel, who had betrayed him. 
However, Kaindel wouldn’t let him go. 
In the end, Isaac fled, unable to endure Kaindel’s refusal to give up either the marriage to the princess or his relationship with Isaac. 
Not long after, rumors began to spread throughout the kingdom: the hero had gone mad.
***
[From Isaac Winter, who once loved you] 
“…….”
Kaindel read and reread the last line of the letter, but the words didn’t change.
‘Once loved.’
Isaac really wrote his feelings in past tense.
“Ah.”
He never thought Isaac would leave him. 
No, he never believed he could be abandoned. 
Even if they parted ways, he was sure it would be on his terms.
Because Isaac loved him.
Because being loved by Isaac was, for Kaindel, something so natural.
“Why…….”
But it had all been an illusion.
“Why didn’t I see it?”
Now, the one left behind like a forgotten relic was Kaindel, him. 
The one clinging to the past, too blind to see the present, was none other than himself. 
He only realized it now, after he left him.
Suddenly, Isaac’s voice, long buried in his memory, resurfaced. 
Isaac’s smiling face filled his vision, his silver eyes, like clear glass marbles, gleaming with a thousand bright stars, painfully vivid.
The sound of Isaac’s innocent laughter echoed in his mind. “I love you,” Isaac had once whispered.
When Kaindel’s mind wondered around, did Isaac’s laughter disappeared? 
No matter how much he tried to remember, the moment escaped him. 
He searched his memory in vain.
As Kaindel traced the days gone by, thick tears began to fall. 
Like melting ice dripping onto the budding new leaves of spring, his tears left indelible marks on Isaac’s letter.
“Where is he?”
“…….”
“Find him.”
“Immediately.”
Kaindel finally crumbled.
In the place where his arrogance shattered, a deep regret settled in.
It was a perfect despair.

89783.synopsis: A poor young man named Zhou Lang accidentally comes across the “Dual Cultivation Manual” and gains extraordinary skills. Have you figured out how your ass is going to bloom?’

91575.synopsis:
Su Li, an ordinary person who lived for 30 years, surviving on social welfare as a laid-back slacker.
Occasional pointless complaining and self-defeating philosophical platitudes didn’t bring any meaning to his 30 years.
Until he was transported to another world…
Su Li, who had no elemental talent, Su Li, who was labeled as useless, lived an unremarkable life.
One day, Su Li picked up a person in distress and told them: “The reason you think light is important is only because darkness pervades the world. When light fills the world, darkness will become important.”
The Son of Light Saint who was betrayed by the Bishop of Light
— He’s right!
He is the sage who guides people forward, the signpost standing before the people, my faith, my everything!
He is not a god, yet he far transcends gods.
Su Li saved an injured mute bird. As birds sang outside the window, he told the bird: “The reason people like things that make beautiful sounds is only because they happen to understand that sound. Because of ignorance, there is no sin.”
The Level 9 demon beast Raven, severely injured by the Mercenary Association:
— All people are ignorant and foolish, thinking that ravens represent evil, even labeling me as a natural disaster. I hate humans the most, but he is the exception.
If the world is what he wants, I too will aspire towards it.
Su Li told his young friend who wanted to go to the big city to strive for success: “Moving upward is human instinct. If one day you fall due to reality, please don’t hate yourself.”
The friend who eventually amassed enough gold coins to fill a city:
I once thought that a child from a remote countryside would never understand everything I pursued. However, heaven blessed me, allowing me to witness true great wisdom…

One day, a mob boss went to see a dentist and met a young doctor there.
The little doctor was so delicate and pretty that the mob boss just wanted to make him cry.
And with such a big bottom, the mob boss just wanted to have his way with him relentlessly.
A thug who appears rough but is actually polite and somewhat naturally flawed * A seemingly aloof doctor who is actually tender, wife-like, and deeply devoted.

Gong – Hei Longba x Shou – Bai Qingshui

93367.synopsis:
I transmigrated into the novel I was fangirling over until my dying breath.

A slit-eyed character who doesn’t discriminate between means and methods, but is dead serious about taking care of his people.
Decadent beauty, an eye-smile that enchants people, and intelligence—the holy trinity embodied in my baby #1!

An iron wall who broke through a glacier.
A lone wolf… my foot. He’s a large dog wearing a wolf’s skin.

A tiny pretty boy overflowing with rebellious charm.
From the mid-section, he grows 20+ cm and transforms into a magnificent beast.

97207.synopsis:
My childhood friend drowned when we were in elementary school.
On the day of his cremation, I remembered how much he loved roasted sweet potatoes, so I placed two in his coffin. Then I realized, sweet potatoes need to be cooked before you can eat them, he wouldn’t be able to eat them raw.
The people at the crematorium told me that once it went inside, the potatoes would be roasted, and my friend would be able to eat them hot.
And then…the smell of roasted sweet potatoes wafted out from the crematorium furnace.
That night, as I slept, I kept feeling someone pulling on my braid, calling me “Old Six” in my ear.
The only person who would do that was my childhood friend, but he was gone.
It must have been a dream, yes, it must have been.

98487.synopsis:
A man returns home after millennia of endless struggle,
Only to find that the sanctuary he yearned for has vanished.

Lee Seojun, the Demon God, dreams of a quiet life with his family.

The Grand Slayer of Demons—the great hero who taught me swordsmanship.

Reborn into the family of my enemy, this second life… I will have my revenge. With magic.

101303.synopsis:
Reinhardt is the third son of a Margrave family. A few months ago, after suffering from a high fever, he recalled that he was a Japanese person in his previous life, working for a black company as an adult. He doesn’t remember how he died. He swore to protect his fun life in this magical world, surrounded by fluffiness, at all costs.
With the help of his family, he leaves troublesome matters to capable others. However, he can’t refuse when someone relies on him.

Su Yi is a workaholic. After continuous 007 shifts [akin to 24/7] , she suddenly died in front of her computer.

Her affectionate mother, unable to hear her daughter’s thoughts, listens to some fortune teller’s nonsense and seeks a husband to bring Su Yi good fortune.
It turns out that the husband found is none other than the female protagonist, who is forced to disguise as a man to escape her enemies.

Female-dominant transmigration novel, 1v1

108471.synopsis:
“My one-sided love was ruined.”  
Compared to his perfect older brother, Ha Giyeon was endlessly inferior.  
His first love, and his last love, they were all his brother’s friends. The one he poured endless affection into returned it with words of cold rejection, as violent as a slap.  
From the family he craved love from, he was met with the thunderous declaration that he wasn’t their real son, and then thrown out of the house. Even when he worked backbreaking labor, his life felt like it wasn’t really living.
Then, a sudden car accident came for Ha Giyeon. On the verge of death, he regretted and wished: If I get to live again, I’ll never pour my love into the family that ignored and discriminated against me, or the brothers who tormented me under the guise of affection. I’ll live my own life, completely for myself.
And then like a lie, at 17 years old, in the middle of winter, Ha Giyeon regressed.  
As Ha Giyeon began to change, so too did his family and brothers…

111287.synopsis:
Ling Yue graduated but was framed and ended up interning at a zoo. She faced exclusion from her colleagues and hostility from her superiors. Just before resigning, she saved someone from a tiger’s mouth and discovered that she could actually hear the voices of animals.
Helping animals fulfil their wishes would earn her rewards?
Black Crow: “Caw caw, this guy is a thief! I just saw him rob a jewellery store, with a bounty of five hundred thousand! He even buried a bag of shiny stuff under the big willow tree by East Lake, brothers, let’s rush!”
The cold black cat she often fed turned out to be the local queenpin? Fulfill its wish and earn a billion-dollar villa!
A dying little mouse in distress was actually a treasure-hunting mouse; fulfill its wish and the mouse recognizes its master, gaining a fortune aura!
A restaurant secretly selling wild game; saving a dying giant tortoise earned her the true teachings of a master: both treasure appraisal and feng shui!
The zoo’s tiger was off its food: “I lift my head, I shed tears, I miss my wife and cubs! Fulfill my wish and gain the aura of the king of the jungle!”
The scope expands, both online and offline flourish!
Ling Yue opened a pet store offline for animal consultations, and online live-streamed animal consultations, where fate could be counted.
Netizens on the orca live-streaming platform discovered someone was live-streaming animal consultations and teased:
[Wow, I’ve heard of consultations for people, but never for animals. The host is a fairy, confirmed!] 
[Fairy sister, take a look at me, I’m sick, suffering from lovesickness.] 
Later—
Five million followers, a pet streamer connects for a consultation, the new cat is vicious and bites people, and it never learns! What to do?
Ling Yue: “Aren’t you the one who fed it thumbtacks, planning to starve it to get a new pet?”
The family parrot suddenly emitted a female voice, calling for a husband every day, wanting kisses, and the female owner suspected a love affair between a person and a bird.

Netizens: “Wow, is this something we can watch for free? Bowing to the master!”

Qin Yun: “Thank you, I’m just an ordinary farmhand”

 “Wh—why… why would you ask something like that? Why would that even matter?”

 And suddenly, the hunters find themselves in desperate need of the walking monster encyclopedia that is Yurian.
